blind.description: A sturdy wooden holding cell or prison gate made of a heavy timber frame enclosing closely spaced vertical wooden bars. A central horizontal reinforcing beam spans across the middle, fitted with dark iron mounting brackets and rivets/bolts on each outer vertical frame member. The textures display stylized dark brown wood grain and matte dark iron hardware.
blind.from_above: A narrow rectangular brown timber strip with slightly wider end caps, flanked centrally by small protruding dark metal bracket hinges on either side.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 6 feet tall (slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4 to 4.5 feet wide.

match.reads_as: tall panel of wooden cage bars in a heavy timber frame
notes: Observer identified it as a barred door/gate due to the vertical bars and framing, but it lacks door hardware/latches and functions cleanly as a cage wall panel with mounting brackets.
